remarks: A timeless Old Hollywood Spanish Revival in the heart of the coveted Hollywood Dell/Beachwood Canyon area, this enchanting, gated residence blends authentic period charm with thoughtful modern updates, lush surroundings, and captivating views of the Griffith Observatory, the canyon, and Downtown Los Angeles. Mature landscaping envelops the property in privacy, while multiple outdoor spaces create an inviting backdrop for intimate gatherings, alfresco entertaining, or quiet moments at home.
